name: Demon Launch
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: A demonic presence animates the ship carrying demon pirates.
disable: DC 17 Religion (trained) to ward against demonic presence, arcana (trained) or DC 17 Occultism (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, DC 17 Intimidation (trained) to scare it away, or sailing-lore|dc:14 (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine:
◆◆ The demon launch uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.

  • Broadside Blast a The demon launch makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
  • Demonic List d Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage.
  • Heads Will Roll a It makes a bowsprit Strike.
  • Sea Chantey a (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 17 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

Effect: Sea Chantey

defensiveAbilities.name: No Prey, No Pay
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The demon launch hits another ship and Encounter A begins

Effect The demon launch fires grapples at the Snapdragon. Each PC must attempt a DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save or be Grabbed (Escape dc=17); on a critical failure, they're also impaled and take (1d6+3) Piercing Damage damage. The demon launch then rolls initiative.
